text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived!
The Grand Masters!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gathered on this stage are the truly elite—
the champions who have conquered the SWBC!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And now, those very girls are challenging to seize the ultimate peak!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Footage of the races held inside VR is also being broadcast on the Turf Visions at racetracks nationwide!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The stands are engulfed in an excitement
rivalling that of a real Gâ  race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loud cheers echo along this path leading to the stage of the Grand Masters as well.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The sun rises, and sets.
Towards the far-off horizon.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: "Yet it will surely rise again. Time and time again, we will meet anew."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Let's see it then—the feelings of those who ran in the past, passed down to you through us.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: The running of the Umamusume racing in this era—
